display_title: Does a Hero Need Work Benefits Too?
description:
I got sucked into a brutal game that I barely managed to beat after playing with everything I had. And now my quest is… managing the hero’s stress?! 

If the hero’s mental state breaks down, the entire world will collapse. And the one who has to take responsibility for that? 

Me?! 

I never agreed to this. But if that’s how it is, fine. I’ll do whatever it takes to keep the hero’s life together. 

From now on, I’m in charge of his “benefits.”
